versos.hebraico: בַּשְּׁבִיעִ֕י בְּעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאֶחָ֖ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָה֙ דְּבַר־יְהוָ֔ה בְּיַד־חַגַּ֥י הַנָּבִ֖יא לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: In the seventh month, in the twenty-first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
controles.kjv: In the seventh month, in the one and twentieth day of the month, came the word of the Lord by the prophet Haggai, saying,
controles.livre: No sétimo mês, no vigésimo primeiro dia mês, veio a palavra do SENHOR por meio do profeta Ageu, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: אֱמָר־נָ֗א אֶל־זְרֻבָּבֶ֤ל בֶּן־שַׁלְתִּיאֵל֙ פַּחַ֣ת יְהוּדָ֔ה וְאֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בֶּן־יְהוֹצָדָ֖ק הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֑וֹל וְאֶל־שְׁאֵרִ֥ית הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: “Speak now to Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,
controles.kjv: Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, and to the residue of the people, saying,
controles.livre: Fala agora a Zorobabel filho de Sealtiel, governador de Judá, e a Josué filho de Jeozadaque, sumo sacerdote, e ao resto do povo, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: מִ֤י בָכֶם֙ הַנִּשְׁאָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר רָאָה֙ אֶת־הַבַּ֣יִת הַזֶּ֔ה בִּכְבוֹד֖וֹ הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן וּמָ֨ה אַתֶּ֜ם רֹאִ֤ים אֹתוֹ֙ עַ֔תָּה הֲל֥וֹא כָמֹ֛הוּ כְּאַ֖יִן בְּעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How do you see it now? Isn’t it in your eyes as nothing?
controles.kjv: Who is left among you that saw this house in her first glory? and how do ye see it now? is it not in your eyes in comparison of it as nothing?
controles.livre: Quem restou dentre vós que tenha visto esta casa em sua primeira glória? E como a vedes agora? Não é esta como nada diante de vossos olhos?

versos.hebraico: וְעַתָּ֣ה חֲזַ֣ק זְרֻבָּבֶ֣ל׀ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֡ה וַחֲזַ֣ק יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בֶּן־יְהוֹצָדָק֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן הַגָּד֜וֹל וַחֲזַ֨ק כָּל־עַ֥ם הָאָ֛רֶץ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֖ה וַֽעֲשׂ֑וּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י אִתְּכֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says Yahweh. ‘Be strong, Joshua, son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ says Yahweh, ‘and work, for I am with you,’ says Yahweh of Armies.
controles.kjv: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, saith the Lord; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the Lord, and work: for I am with you, saith the Lord of hosts:
controles.livre: Agora, pois, esforça-te, Zorobabel, diz o SENHOR; esforça-te também Josué, filho de Jeozadaque, sumo sacerdote; e esforça-te, todo o povo da terra, diz o SENHOR, e trabalhai; porque eu estou convosco, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.

versos.hebraico: אֶֽת־הַדָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־כָּרַ֤תִּי אִתְּכֶם֙ בְּצֵאתְכֶ֣ם מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם וְרוּחִ֖י עֹמֶ֣דֶת בְּתוֹכְכֶ֑ם אַל־תִּירָֽאוּ׃ס

controles.web: This is the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, and my Spirit lived among you. ‘Don’t be afraid.’
controles.kjv: According to the word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt, so my spirit remaineth among you: fear ye not.
controles.livre: Conforme o pacto que estabeleci convosco quando saístes do Egito, assim meu Espírito está em meio de vós; não temais.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת ע֥וֹד אַחַ֖ת מְעַ֣ט הִ֑יא וַאֲנִ֗י מַרְעִישׁ֙ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְאֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאֶת־הַיָּ֖ם וְאֶת־הֶחָרָבָֽה׃

controles.web: For this is what Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the dry land;
controles.kjv: For thus saith the Lord of hosts; Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land;
controles.livre: Porque assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Ainda uma vez, daqui a pouco, eu farei tremer os céus e a terra, o mar e a terra seca;

versos.hebraico: וְהִרְעַשְׁתִּי֙ אֶת־כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וּבָ֖אוּ חֶמְדַּ֣ת כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וּמִלֵּאתִ֞י אֶת־הַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ כָּב֔וֹד אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: and I will shake all nations. The precious things of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says Yahweh of Armies.
controles.kjv: And I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, saith the Lord of hosts.
controles.livre: E farei tremer a todas as nações, e virá as coisas preciosas de todas as nações; e encherei esta casa de glória, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.

versos.hebraico: לִ֥י הַכֶּ֖סֶף וְלִ֣י הַזָּהָ֑ב נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine,’ says Yahweh of Armies.
controles.kjv: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, saith the Lord of hosts.
controles.livre: Minha é a prata, e meu é o ouro, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.

versos.hebraico: גָּד֣וֹל יִֽהְיֶ֡ה כְּבוֹד֩ הַבַּ֨יִת הַזֶּ֤ה הָאַֽחֲרוֹן֙ מִן־הָ֣רִאשׁ֔וֹן אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וּבַמָּק֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן שָׁל֔וֹם נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃פ

controles.web: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says Yahweh of Armies; ‘and in this place will I give peace,’ says Yahweh of Armies.”
controles.kjv: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith the Lord of hosts: and in this place will I give peace, saith the Lord of hosts.
controles.livre: A glória desta última casa será maior que a da primeira, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos; e neste lugar darei paz, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.

versos.hebraico: בְּעֶשְׂרִ֤ים וְאַרְבָּעָה֙ לַתְּשִׁיעִ֔י בִּשְׁנַ֥ת שְׁתַּ֖יִם לְדָרְיָ֑וֶשׁ הָיָה֙ דְּבַר־יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־חַגַּ֥י הַנָּבִ֖יא לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: In the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, Yahweh’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
controles.kjv: In the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet, saying,
controles.livre: Ao vigésimo quarto dia do nono mês, no segundo ano de Dario, veio a palavra do SENHOR por mão do profeta Ageu, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת שְׁאַל־נָ֧א אֶת־הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים תּוֹרָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: “Thus says Yahweh of Armies: Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,
controles.kjv: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,
controles.livre: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Pergunta agora aos sacerdotes acerca da lei, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: הֵ֣ן׀ יִשָּׂא־אִ֨ישׁ בְּשַׂר־קֹ֜דֶשׁ בִּכְנַ֣ף בִּגְד֗וֹ וְנָגַ֣ע בִּ֠כְנָפוֹ אֶל־הַלֶּ֨חֶם וְאֶל־הַנָּזִ֜יד וְאֶל־הַיַּ֧יִן וְאֶל־שֶׁ֛מֶן וְאֶל־כָּל־מַאֲכָ֖ל הֲיִקְדָּ֑שׁ וַיַּעֲנ֧וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹֽא׃

controles.web: ‘If someone carries holy meat in the fold of his garment, and with his fold touches bread, stew, wine, oil, or any food, will it become holy?’”   The priests answered, “No.”
controles.kjv: If one bear holy flesh in the skirt of his garment, and with his skirt do touch bread, or pottage, or wine, or oil, or any meat, shall it be holy? And the priests answered and said, No.
controles.livre: Se alguém levar carnes santas na borda de sua veste, e com sua borda tocar o pão, a comida, o vinho, o azeite, ou qualquer outra comida, por acaso isso será santificado?E os sacerdotes responderam: Não.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר חַגַּ֔י אִם־יִגַּ֧ע טְמֵא־נֶ֛פֶשׁ בְּכָל־אֵ֖לֶּה הֲיִטְמָ֑א וַיַּעֲנ֧וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ יִטְמָֽא׃

controles.web: Then Haggai said, “If one who is unclean by reason of a dead body touch any of these, will it be unclean?”   The priests answered, “It will be unclean.”
controles.kjv: Then said Haggai, If one that is unclean by a dead body touch any of these, shall it be unclean? And the priests answered and said, It shall be unclean.
controles.livre: E Ageu disse: Se um impuro por causa de um corpo morto tocar alguma destas coisas, ela será impura? E os sacerdotes responderam: Impura será.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֨עַן חַגַּ֜י וַיֹּ֗אמֶר כֵּ֣ן הָֽעָם־הַ֠זֶּה וְכֵן־הַגּ֨וֹי הַזֶּ֤ה לְפָנַי֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה וְכֵ֖ן כָּל־מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְדֵיהֶ֑ם וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יַקְרִ֛יבוּ שָׁ֖ם טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא׃

controles.web: Then Haggai answered, “‘So is this people, and so is this nation before me,’ says Yahweh; ‘and so is every work of their hands. That which they offer there is unclean.
controles.kjv: Then answered Haggai, and said, So is this people, and so is this nation before me, saith the Lord; and so is every work of their hands; and that which they offer there is unclean.
controles.livre: Então Ageu respondeu: Assim é este povo, esta nação, diante de mim, diz o SENHOR; e assim é toda obra de suas mãos; e todo o que ali oferecem é impuro.

versos.hebraico: וְעַתָּה֙ שִֽׂימוּ־נָ֣א לְבַבְכֶ֔ם מִן־הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה מִטֶּ֧רֶם שֽׂוּם־אֶ֛בֶן אֶל־אֶ֖בֶן בְּהֵיכַ֥ל יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Now, please consider from this day and backward, before a stone was laid on a stone in Yahweh’s temple.
controles.kjv: And now, I pray you, consider from this day and upward, from before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of the Lord:
controles.livre: Agora pois, considerai  desde este dia em diante, antes que se ponha pedra sobre pedra no templo do SENHOR,

versos.hebraico: מִֽהְיוֹתָ֥ם בָּא֙ אֶל־עֲרֵמַ֣ת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְהָיְתָ֖ה עֲשָׂרָ֑ה בָּ֣א אֶל־הַיֶּ֗קֶב לַחְשֹׂף֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים פּוּרָ֔ה וְהָיְתָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִֽים׃

controles.web: Through all that time, when one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When one came to the wine vat to draw out fifty, there were only twenty.
controles.kjv: Since those days were, when one came to an heap of twenty measures, there were but ten: when one came to the pressfat for to draw out fifty vessels out of the press, there were but twenty.
controles.livre: Antes que fossem estas coisas, vinham ao amontoado de grão de vinte medidas ,e obtinham somente dez; vinham ao lagar para tirar cinquenta vasos do lagar, mas obtinham somente vinte.

versos.hebraico: הִכֵּ֨יתִי אֶתְכֶ֜ם בַּשִּׁדָּפ֤וֹן וּבַיֵּֽרָקוֹן֙ וּבַבָּרָ֔ד אֵ֖ת כָּל־מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְדֵיכֶ֑ם וְאֵין־אֶתְכֶ֥ם אֵלַ֖י נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: I struck you with blight, mildew, and hail in all the work of your hands; yet you didn’t turn to me,’ says Yahweh.
controles.kjv: I smote you with blasting and with mildew and with hail in all the labours of your hands; yet ye turned not to me, saith the Lord.
controles.livre: Eu vos feri com ferrugem, mofo, e granizo em toda obra de vossas mãos; mas não vos convertestes a mim,diz o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: שִׂימוּ־נָ֣א לְבַבְכֶ֔ם מִן־הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה מִיּוֹם֩ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֜ה לַתְּשִׁיעִ֗י לְמִן־הַיּ֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יֻסַּ֥ד הֵֽיכַל־יְהוָ֖ה שִׂ֥ימוּ לְבַבְכֶֽם׃

controles.web: ‘Consider, please, from this day and backward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, since the day that the foundation of Yahweh’s temple was laid, consider it.
controles.kjv: Consider now from this day and upward, from the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, even from the day that the foundation of the Lord’s temple was laid, consider it.
controles.livre: Considerai, pois, isto, desde este dia em diante, desde o dia vigésimo quatro dia do nono mês, desde o dia em o fundamento do templo do SENHOR foi posto; considerai.

versos.hebraico: הַע֤וֹד הַזֶּ֨רַע֙ בַּמְּגוּרָ֔ה וְעַד־הַגֶּ֨פֶן וְהַתְּאֵנָ֧ה וְהָרִמּ֛וֹן וְעֵ֥ץ הַזַּ֖יִת לֹ֣א נָשָׂ֑א מִן־הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה אֲבָרֵֽךְ׃ס

controles.web: Is the seed yet in the barn? Yes, the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree haven’t produced. From this day will I bless you.’”
controles.kjv: Is the seed yet in the barn? yea, as yet the vine, and the fig tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive tree, hath not brought forth: from this day will I bless you.
controles.livre: Ainda há semente no celeiro? A videira, a figueira, a romeira, e oliveira ainda não têm dado frutos; mas a partir de hoje eu vos abençoarei.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֨י דְבַר־יְהוָ֤ה׀ שֵׁנִית֙ אֶל־חַגַּ֔י בְּעֶשְׂרִ֧ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֛ה לַחֹ֖דֶשׁ לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh’s word came the second time to Haggai in the twenty-fourth day of the month, saying,
controles.kjv: And again the word of the Lord came unto Haggai in the four and twentieth day of the month, saying,
controles.livre: E a palavra do SENHOR veio pela segunda vez a Ageu, ao vigésimo quarto dia do mês, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: אֱמֹ֕ר אֶל־זְרֻבָּבֶ֥ל פַּֽחַת־יְהוּדָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר אֲנִ֣י מַרְעִ֔ישׁ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: “Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, ‘I will shake the heavens and the earth.
controles.kjv: Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, I will shake the heavens and the earth;
controles.livre: Fala a Zorobabel, governador de Judá, dizendo: Eu farei tremer os céus e a terra;

versos.hebraico: וְהָֽפַכְתִּי֙ כִּסֵּ֣א מַמְלָכ֔וֹת וְהִ֨שְׁמַדְתִּ֔י חֹ֖זֶק מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וְהָפַכְתִּ֤י מֶרְכָּבָה֙ וְרֹ֣כְבֶ֔יהָ וְיָרְד֤וּ סוּסִים֙ וְרֹ֣כְבֵיהֶ֔ם אִ֖ישׁ בְּחֶ֥רֶב אָחִֽיו׃

controles.web: I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms. I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations. I will overthrow the chariots, and those who ride in them. The horses and their riders will come down, everyone by the sword of his brother.
controles.kjv: And I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms, and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the heathen; and I will overthrow the chariots, and those that ride in them; and the horses and their riders shall come down, every one by the sword of his brother.
controles.livre: E transtornarei o trono dos reinos, e destruirei a força dos reinos das nações; e transtornarei as carruagens, e os que nelas se sentam; e os cavalos e os que neles montam cairão, cada um pela espada de seu irmão.

versos.hebraico: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֣וּא נְאֻם־יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֡וֹת אֶ֠קָּחֲךָ זְרֻבָּבֶ֨ל בֶּן־שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵ֤ל עַבְדִּי֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה וְשַׂמְתִּ֖יךָ כַּֽחוֹתָ֑ם כִּֽי־בְךָ֣ בָחַ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: In that day, says Yahweh of Armies, will I take you, Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel,’ says Yahweh, ‘and will make you as a signet, for I have chosen you,’ says Yahweh of Armies.”
controles.kjv: In that day, saith the Lord of hosts, will I take thee, O Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel, saith the Lord, and will make thee as a signet: for I have chosen thee, saith the Lord of hosts.
controles.livre: Naquele dia, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, eu te tomarei, Zorobabel, filho de Sealtiel, servo meu, diz o SENHOR, e te porei como anel de selar; porque eu te escolhi, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.
